subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

The new building was being constructed by the construction workers.

options.text: The construction workers were constructing the new building.
The construction workers had been constructing the new building.
The new building has being constructed by the construction workers?
The new building is being constructed by the construction workers.

solution:
The correct answer is** "The construction workers were constructing the new building."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in Past Continuous Tense and in Passive Voice.
 
• The rule for changing a Past Continuous Tense from Active voice to Passive voice or Passive to Active Voice:
 
 
• Interchange the object and subject with each other, i.e. object of the active sentence become the subject of the passive sentence.
 
• Structure: 
 
 
• Subject + was/were + v1 + ing + object (Active Voice)__
 
• Object + was/were + being + V3 + by Subject __(Passive Voice)__ 
 
 
 
• Example: 
 
 
• *Esha was singing a song.** *(Active Voice)
 
• *A song was being sung by Esha.** *(Passive Voice)​​
 
 
 
 
 
• The subject of the given sentence is 'Construction workers'.​​
 
• The object of the given sentence is 'new building.' 
 
• The subject will be put in place of the object and the object will be put in place of the subject.
 
• 'Was being constructed' will be changed into 'were constructing'. 
 
• "Construction workers" is a plural subject so we must "were" with it.
 
• The correct option 1 follows all the above rules and correctly expresses the given sentence in active voice.
